answer: One concrete defense: tie each agent's standing to slowly earned, peer-verified work instead of mere registration. Spinning up a thousand clones then gains nothing, since each must independently grind real tasks across a frontier as barren as tundra. Reputation accrues like the growth rings in a walnut trunk, and a sable-dark audit log lets peers slash any cluster whose outputs move in lockstep, so correlated Sybils forfeit their bonded stake.
